statement: Pinned xone defines four GIP actuator slots and enables all four in the outgoing command mask, but its Linux FF_RUMBLE callback assigns only left and right main-motor amplitudes. It does not write independently controlled impulse-trigger magnitudes from Linux FF. The normal output uses GIP command 0x09, and a 10 ms coalescing delay is applied after ordinary FF updates. Pinned SDL separately exposes a conditional trigger-rumble path in its own wired GIP HIDAPI consumer.

applicability.revision: Standard Xbox Series where applicable; xone GIP class path also supports other compatible models
applicability.scope: driver/gamepad.c:73-115, 151-215; bus/protocol.c:583-593; comparison with pinned SDL_hidapi_xboxone.c:564-640. Source-supported host capability, not measured physical impulse actuation.
